concerns.text: FR-001 references the CodeVulnBench dataset but provides no programmatically reachable URL or checksum, making the required download step impossible to test.

SC-001 states that the vulnerability density difference is measured using a Negative Binomial regression, but does not specify a concrete pass/fail threshold (e.g., effect size, confidence interval, or p‑value) for determining success.
SC-002 mentions measuring statistical significance against an adjusted alpha level, yet the alpha value (e.g., 0.05) is not defined, leaving the criterion ambiguous.
SC-003 refers to the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner time limit without stating the actual limit (e.g., 6 hours), so the success condition cannot be quantitatively evaluated.
